where: The Rimeway (the star-tenders' high road over the frost col above the Pale Vault, a line of dead rime-lamps)
mood: Lonely and grand: wind over a high frost col, a line of dead rime-lamps marching into the cold, the glacier far below.
_motif_note: Low strength keeps the Rimeway's own lonely-grand identity while sharing the score's tune; 90 BPM matches the motif's tempo grid.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor with suspended and quartal chords
a lonely pulse-wave lead with long held notes, wide rising leaps
glassy suspended harp arpeggios in stacked fifths
slow glass bell chimes like cold lamps
broad sampled string chords that swell into grandeur
an airy flute answering from far away
soft timpani and processional tom rolls
lonely and grand, a high frozen mountain pass under aurora, wind across the snow

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {opens at once on a broad cold string chord and a ringing glass bell, like a lamp struck on the col, then thins to wind and harp for the lead}
styles: full presence from the first beat

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lonely lead over open fifths: a wide rising leap held long on a suspended chord, then a slow step down; glass chimes at phrase ends}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, a distant flute answering each phrase, harp arpeggios in stacked fifths shimmering like aurora}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast, grandeur: full strings and processional timpani, the leap widened and climbing a step each phrase in F major, ending on a bright D major}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lonely lead returns over the wind and cold chimes; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
